name: Veg Patch
summary: A glass-fronted garden bed: plant, water and harvest tomatoes, carrots and sunflowers
about: A raised bed with a glass front stands by a picket fence, so you see the roots, the carrots and a wriggling worm underground as well as the plants above. Drop a seed in, send the watering can over to soak the soil, and watch it sprout, leaf out, flower and ripen while it leans toward the sun and a bee drops by; ripe crops wiggle, pop out and fly into a basket that adds up their value in rupees. Good for a farm shop, a kids learning page or a gardening blog.
how: Pick Tomato, Carrot or Sunflower, then tap an empty spot in the bed (each spot is a button) to plant it.
Tap a growing plant, or press Water all, and the watering can flies over and pours; plants only grow while the soil is wet and droop when it dries.
When a plant is ripe a ring pulses under it: tap it to harvest and the crop flies into the basket, which keeps a running total.
Move your pointer over the sky to move the sun; the stems and the sunflower turn toward it.
With reduced motion the plants do not sway, the can moves faster and there are fewer particles.
